# commands
$ acerctl setup
nothing to do: everything the firmware offers is set up
[exit 0]
$ acerctl mode quiet
[exit 0]
$ acerctl mode performance
[exit 0]
$ acerctl fan all max
[exit 0]
$ acerctl fan cpu 40
[exit 0]
$ acerctl fan all auto
[exit 0]
$ acerctl kbd timeout 0
acerctl: not supported: keyboard backlight timeout is not available on this hardware
[exit 1]
$ acerctl usb-charging 20
[exit 0]
$ acerctl battery limit off
[exit 0]
$ acerctl battery limit on
[exit 0]
$ acerctl battery calibrate start
[exit 0]
